subject.title: [Performance]: Profile buildSessionEntry memory pressure during large-agent full reindex

question: Should this issue remain open until a maintainer or tester captures large-agent full-reindex RSS/heap proof, or should it be closed now as unconfirmed?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the plausible hotspot, but the issue explicitly asks not to patch without live memory evidence and automation does not have the reported large-agent corpus.

options.title: Keep open for profiling
options.body: Leave this issue open and ask a maintainer or tester with a large corpus to capture the requested RSS/heap/stability evidence before any code change.

options.title: Close as unconfirmed
options.body: Close this issue if maintainers do not want to spend manual profiling time without a reproduced OOM or unsafe peak RSS.

options.title: Sponsor a measured fix
options.body: After profiling shows unsafe memory pressure, sponsor a narrow change such as streaming parsing or file-size-aware concurrency with regression proof.

recommendation.title: Keep open for profiling
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and ask a maintainer or tester with a large corpus to capture the requested RSS/heap/stability evidence before any code change.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal across the memory engine and session indexing files.
